aboutUs.title: Architecting the Future of Construction Estimation
aboutUs.subtitle: APEX is a smart digital platform for the accurate calculation and estimation of construction material quantities — built by computer science students at Ibn Khaldoun University, Tiaret.
aboutUs.missionDesc: To eliminate manual estimation errors in the Algerian construction industry by providing engineers, architects, and quantity surveyors with a precise, automated, and standards-compliant calculation platform.
aboutUs.storyDesc: Born from a final-year Bachelor's project in Computer Systems at Ibn Khaldoun University (2025–2026), APEX was built by 11 specialized sub-groups, each tackling a distinct construction domain. Together, they created a platform where structural logic, material databases, and AI-assisted guidance converge into one cohesive engine.
aboutUs.quote: APEX isn't just software — it's the digital backbone of modern construction planning in Algeria.
aboutUs.quoteAuthor: Dr. Abdelkader BOUGUESSA, Supervisor · MCB, University of Tiaret
aboutUs.modulesSubtitle: Each module is responsible for a distinct construction domain, sharing the same backend infrastructure, REST API layer, and PostgreSQL database schema.

modules.majorWorksDesc: Foundations (insulated footings, raft slabs), excavation & backfill volumes, C25/C30 concrete dosing, reinforcement, and truck transport calculation.
modules.finishingDesc: Painting, plastering, tiling, and high-end aesthetic finishes with configurable waste margins per material type.
modules.doorsWindowsDesc: Glazing surface calculation (hauteur × largeur), timber, aluminium, PVC, and security door coefficients, with PDF report export and email delivery.
modules.interiorDesc: Kitchen estimation (MDF/marble/inox), sanitary fixtures (washbasins, toilets, showers), with full DZD material catalog and quantity formulas.
modules.costServiceDesc: Real-time USD→DZD conversion via Exchange Rate API. Three budget levels (Optimistic / Normal / Pessimistic) with automatic parallel market factor (×1.7) for imported materials.
modules.aiAssistantDesc: Bilingual (EN/AR) chatbot powered by Llama 3.3 70B via Groq API. 168 predefined Q&A entries covering Algerian construction standards, plus free-text expert mode with quota-based subscription control.

aboutUs.techSubtitle: Every component of APEX is designed for interoperability, maintainability, and real-world Algerian construction workflows.
aboutUs.coreLogicDesc: The principles that drive every line of code in the APEX Engine.
aboutUs.joinUs: A collaborative academic project by computer science students dedicated to solving real-world AEC estimation challenges in Algeria.

values.precisionDesc: Every calculation is evaluated in real time against structural logic patterns using math.js. Results are rounded to Algerian civil engineering standards and verified through functional test suites.
values.flexibilityDesc: A recursive category engine that adapts from residential door frames to full urban infrastructure — with configurable formulas, field definitions, and coefficient tables per category.
values.innovationDesc: Llama 3.3 70B powers domain-constrained expert guidance. The system prompt restricts responses strictly to civil engineering in Algeria, with per-user quota tracking and automatic cycle resets.

faq.title: Technical Insights
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the APEX calculation engine.
faq.q1: How does the formula evaluation work?
faq.a1: APEX uses math.js to parse and evaluate mathematical expressions in real time. Field variables (hauteur, largeur, quantite) are mapped to their category definitions and evaluated dynamically — no code changes are required to update a formula.
faq.q2: How are costs converted to Algerian Dinars?
faq.a2: The External Cost Estimation module fetches live USD/DZD exchange rates via an external API, then applies a ×1.7 parallel market factor to reflect real Algerian import costs. Three budget levels (Optimistic, Normal, Pessimistic) are generated from each material's min/unit/max price.
faq.q3: How does the AI Assistant work?
faq.a3: The AI chatbot offers two modes: a static FAQ from 168 predefined bilingual Q&A entries, and a free-text expert mode powered by Llama 3.3 70B via Groq API — constrained to civil engineering and construction topics in Algeria, with per-subscription usage quotas.
